correctness.rationale: The established Burton–Pemantle transfer-current determinant yields Cov(I_e,I_f)=-K(e,f)^2. With Walsh eigenfunctions of cube Laplacian 2|S|, differences of characters select singleton- or two-coordinate subsets, and 1/|S| as an integral gives A_d(r) and B_d(r). Positive integrands yield strict sign and ordering. Interior Laplace saddle t=1-2rho, boundary saddle t=0, and central scaling t=u/sqrt(d) give the constants, exponents and Gaussian functions with the claimed domains. Independently grounded rational Laplacian inversion agrees with exact integral sums for all 4,12,32 hypercube edges at d=2,3,4.
